765-1479-8338.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

224-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull is a creature and has at least two charge counters on it.
224-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Hearthhull
Repeat.

222-527-6968-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6968-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3025-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-4518-4742-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

645-914-3750-6495.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-3750-6495.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.
645-914-3750-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1308-2557-4365-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1018-1987-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2364-4574-4659-4750-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
2364-4574-4659-4750-6842.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Flux Channeler triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mana Vault, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mana Vault from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mana Vault.
Repeat.

2837-5929-7827.description:
Cast Thorin by paying {3}{R}{W}.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters as a Dwarf due to Leyline of Transformation, Thorin triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

2104-5913-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

465-4605-5147-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-4605-5147-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

628-4050-7187.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-4050-7187.notes: Once you have enough colored mana, you can remove the additional -1/-1 counter each loop from Hovel Hurler to give your other creatures infinite power.

250-779-1479-3875-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3875-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

232-1235-4477-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-3062-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Vorinclex and Pir, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

640-2511-5010-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1597-1978-2392.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat

4186-4716-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4716-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5060-5147-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-5060-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1365-1651-2034-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2034-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

997-1537-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

6323-6325.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
6323-6325.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Jumbo Cactuar.
6323-6325.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Wall of Reverence triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Jumbo Cactuar's power.

3560-4050-6290.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
3560-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

509-549-1267-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-549-1267-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-549-1267-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

2350-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

500-4377-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one Cormela token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the original Cormela and the token Cormela die, their abilities trigger, returning Walk the Aeons and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

307-2792-3960.notablePrerequisites:
Walker of Secret Ways and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Walker of Secret Ways or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}.
307-2792-3960.description:
Declare Great Whale and Walker of Secret Ways as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Walker of Secret Ways from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Walker of Secret Ways's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Walker of Secret Ways onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

777-849-1117-3689-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {2}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {R}.
When Junk Diver dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Repeat.

457-1379-1486-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Magda.
457-1379-1486-4222.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Magda, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability.

539-1636-2459-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-2459-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

240-439-643-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
Arashin Sovereign dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing Arashin Sovereign from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power.
Repeat.

225-3875-4967.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-3875-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

147-1878-2034-4558.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
147-1878-2034-4558.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning either Dualcaster Mage or any other nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, targeting Jeska's Will.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, creating a copy of Jeska's Will.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

614-1987-3075-3941.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
614-1987-3075-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

731-1525-2396-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Corrupted Conscience and Ophidian Eye attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
731-1525-2396-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
